title: paralbizzia turgida
intro: Paralbizzia turgida, commonly known as the "Malabar Neem", is a plant species that belongs to the family Meliaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in reducing fever, relieving digestive issues, and treating skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Paralbizzia turgida include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and act as a natural insecticide. The bioactive constituents of this plant include azadirachtin, meliacine, and nimbin, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential benefits in various health applications.
